end.summary: Practised checking answers by estimating first.
end.parentNote: Kabir practised rounding numbers and comparing an estimate with an exact answer. They correctly used nearby numbers in two unaided attempts. They mixed up the idea that an exact answer must match the estimate; this was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, ask Kabir to estimate one addition or subtraction before solving it exactly, then discuss whether the exact answer is near the estimate.
